notes.title: First Bug Patch (woohoo)
notes.content:
Fixed the following bugs:

- Opening the settings menu during combat broke the level progression
- Pressing "Start Round" while UpgradeUI was active would also break level progression
- Bulldozers moving and spinning like ballerinas even after they died
- Pressing ESC while building would leave the area of influence indicator active

I also changed the dark ground to be darker for *mood*
